newsitem.title: USA: Santa Anita revises alliance with Colony.
newsitem.headline: Santa Anita revises alliance with Colony.

text.p: Santa Anita Cos and Colony Capital Inc said Wednesday they revised an agreement regarding a proposed strategic alliance between them.

The companies said in a release that they jointly agreed on a revision that will permit full consideration by Santa Anita of alternative strategic transactions, adding it was "in the best interests of all Santa Anita shareholders."

The alliance permits Santa Anita to enter into discussions and negotiations with third parties for transactions that might involve a transfer of control or some other arrangement that maximizes shareholder value.
Colony Capital, a Los Angeles-based international, private real estate investment firm, last August entered into an agreement to invest over time a total of $138 million in Santa Anita.
